# appdynamics_health_rule (Data Source)

Retrieves the details of a specific AppDynamics health rule by ID. Use the appdynamics_health_rules data source to discover health_rule_id values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_health_rule" "high_cpu" {
  application_id = 42
  health_rule_id = 205
}

output "high_cpu_affects" {
  value = data.appdynamics_health_rule.high_cpu.affects_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application this health rule belongs to.
- `health_rule_id` (Number) ID of the health rule to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `affects_json` (String) JSON object for the Affects block. See the appdynamics_health_rule resource docs for the shape.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `eval_criterias_json` (String) JSON object for the EvalCriterias block. See the appdynamics_health_rule resource docs for the shape.
- `name` (String)
- `schedule_name` (String)
- `use_data_from_last_n_minutes` (Number) Evaluation window in minutes.
- `wait_time_after_violation` (Number) Minutes to wait after a violation before re-evaluating.
